he.text: Say from אַשְׁרֵי page 1, till שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה page 4, after which say the following—

en.text: Say from “for thou hearest prayer,” page 2, till “for it is great,” page 7ᶜ after which say the following—

editorial_expansion: Hebrew names Ashrei through Shomea tefillah. English starts with the Ashrei ending for thou hearest prayer, but cites page 2, and ends for it is great page 7. Use the complete preliminary range; retain divergent documentary citations. Superscript-like c after 7 has no corresponding note; pending image review.
